name: ArKaos MediaMaster Remote Player
notes: Complete list: 1 action (send, index.js:88 inside initActions) and no feedbacks (the module never calls setFeedbackDefinitions). Only 1 action exists, so fewer than five entries could be compared with the source and the status is read, not verified-sample.

Protocol: plain TCP (TCPHelper) to the ArKaos Hub remote player of MediaMaster 6; config fields host (regex Regex.IP, default empty) and port (default 45678, regex Regex.PORT) in config.js. Every command is sent as the option text plus CRLF; nothing is sent when the socket is not connected or the text is empty. Incoming data is only stored in the variable tcp_response when the config keys saveresponse/convertresponse are set, but config.js defines neither field, so the variable stays empty in practice.

The option definition lives in fields.js (FIELDS.cmd) and is written with type 'string' (not a Companion input type, hence type other with rawType string) and useVariables: 'true' (a string, not a boolean; recorded here as true). The source sets no label other than 'Command to execute' and default ''.

The command text is free. The module's presets (presets.js, not catalogued as data) use these values: Orientation, Fullscreen:On, Fullscreen:Off, Controller:First, Controller:Previous, Controller:Play, Controller:Pause, Controller:Stop, Controller:Next, Controller:Last, Controller:Final15, Controller:Final30, Properties:Audio, Properties:Colors, Properties:Effect, Properties:Loop, Properties:Mixing, Properties:Output, Properties:Position, Properties:Visual, View:Remote Player, View:Saga Encoder, View:Transfer, and Cue:<n> for cue numbers 1 to 4095 (the loop at presets.js:406 generates 256 to 4095). These come from the presets only; whether the ArKaos Hub accepts anything else was not checked.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.7.0: options do not support expressions. The class in index.js is still named GenericTcpUdpInstance (copied from the generic module template).
